title: Senior Financial Analyst FP&A – Lifestyle Brands
description:
Overview:

**Catalyst Brands** is seeking a **Senior Financial Analyst** to support financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis for our **Lifestyle Brands** division, namely Aéropostale, Lucky Brand, and Nautica. This hybrid role is based in our **New York, NY** corporate office or our **Lyndhurst, NJ** finance office (preferred).

This position partners directly with Finance, Accounting, and Brand business leaders to evaluate performance across retail, e-commerce, and wholesale channels. You will analyze business drivers, explain financial variances, and deliver actionable insights that shape strategic business decisions.

The ideal candidate is an independent, self-starting professional who can own their work from end-to-end. You should blend proficient financial planning and analysis (FP&A) skills with a corporate accounting foundation, possessing an innate curiosity, a meticulous process for validating data, and the ability to translate operational activities into clear, strategic financial narratives.

Responsibilities:

* **Financial Planning & Analysis:** Drive and support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning across retail, e-commerce, wholesale, and corporate operations. We are looking for hands-on partners who actively build and shape forecasts, not just compile reports.
* **Independent Ownership:** Take personal ownership of assigned business areas, forecasts, or recurring deliverables with limited supervision.
* **Analytical Modeling:** Build, maintain, and substantially improve sophisticated, driver-based financial models in Excel with clearly documented, reasonable assumptions that help the business make decisions.
* **Variance & Performance Analysis:** Analyze sales, gross margin, operating expenses (SG&A), and overall profitability against budget, forecast, and prior periods. Proactively investigate unexpected variances, identify underlying root causes, and recommend actionable solutions.
* **Accounting & General Ledger Integrity:** Analyze GL accounts and transaction-level details to validate monthly financial results and explain how accounting activity flows into financial statements. Partner closely with Accounting during month-end close to assess accrual needs and resolve discrepancies.
* **Commercial Analysis:** Partner cross-functionally with non-finance teams to understand operating plans and analyze the impacts of pricing strategies, product volume, category mix, and product costs on sales and gross margin performance across different brand channels.
* **Executive Presentation & Communication:** Partner cross-functionally to prepare and present clear financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations. You must be able to explain complex financial concepts clearly and confidently to both Finance and non-Finance business partners.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 2 or more years of relevant, hands-on experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or a combination of corporate accounting and financial analysis.
* **Advanced Excel Capabilities:** High proficiency with advanced Excel features (including lookups, SUMIFS, index/match, pivot tables, and driver-based modeling) with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot formulas.
* **Data Validation & Accuracy:** A structured, rigorous process for self-auditing, reconciling, and checking your own work for accuracy and completeness before presenting results to leadership.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to work productively with non-finance partners to resolve issues and improve forecast accuracy.

**Preferred:**

* **Business Model Knowledge:** Solid working knowledge of retail (brick-and-mortar/e-commerce) and/or wholesale business models, including their unique financial drivers.
* **Industry Experience:** Prior finance or accounting experience within the apparel, footwear, retail, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) sectors.
* **Enterprise Systems:** Experience with enterprise systems and reporting tools, such as Oracle, OneStream, or MicroStrategy.

**What You Get**

If eligible, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical/dental/vision, term life insurance, paid vacation/holidays\*, and 401(k) with Company match. All associates are eligible for an associate discount on Catalyst Brands merchandise. For paid holidays, associates who are eligible for paid vacation (MTO) are also eligible for eight paid holidays during the calendar year. All store hourly associates scheduled to work on a designated holiday will receive additional compensation. \*For paid vacation days, as well as eligibility requirements for other benefits, please visit www.catalystbrandsbenefits.com

**About Catalyst**

Catalyst Brands reflects the bringing together the rich heritages of our brands with modern excitement and a new vision for success. Five iconic brands came together under a unified powerhouse portfolio to celebrate the essence of American style. We will leverage our rich history, resources and best-in-class industry talent to further build the success of our brands. At Catalyst we are united in one shared purpose: We exist to ignite America’s most beloved retail brands to make fashion accessible to all.

Working at Catalyst means joining a dedicated team of associates who are encouraged to be uniquely themselves in a safe, caring and welcoming environment. It is a place where careers prosper, accomplishments are celebrated and diversity flourishes. It’s a place that’s meant for you.

For more opportunities to join our team please visit our careers page.

title: FP&A Analyst III
description:
Overview:

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented FP&A Analyst III to support expense analysis, planning, forecasting, and reporting. This individual-contributor role is designed for an experienced finance professional who can independently manage recurring analytical deliverables, work effectively with large datasets, and translate financial results into clear business insights.

The role will partner closely with business stakeholders and finance teams to support expense management, budgeting, allocations, and management reporting. The successful candidate will combine strong financial acumen, technical capability, and a hands-on approach, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and automate recurring FP&A workflows.

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong ownership, accuracy, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to leverage financial systems, data tools, and emerging technologies, including AI, to improve efficiency and insight generation. **This role will require on-site attendance 4 days per week****in Jersey City, NJ.**

Responsibilities:

* Analyze expenses across business units and functions, including actual versus budget, forecast, and prior-period variance analysis; identify and clearly explain key drivers.
* Support annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and long-range planning activities for expenses, including the development and maintenance of allocation methodologies and cost drivers.
* Prepare recurring expense reporting packages, management analyses, and clear presentations for finance and business stakeholders.
* Maintain and enhance financial models, datasets, reports, and dashboards using Excel, Power Query, Power BI, and related tools.
* Work with large, structured datasets; perform reconciliations and validation procedures to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across planning and reporting outputs.
* Support the design, testing, and implementation of expense planning and reporting processes within Oracle or similar enterprise financial systems.
* Partner with business and functional teams to understand expense trends, operating drivers, risks, and opportunities.
* Identify and implement practical improvements to recurring expense reporting, forecasting, and data-preparation processes.
* Use automation and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to enhance financial analysis, reporting quality, and workflow efficiency.
* Maintain clear documentation, controls, assumptions, and audit trails for financial models, allocation processes, and reporting outputs.
* Independently manage assigned deliverables, escalate issues promptly, and meet established reporting and planning deadlines.
* Support ad hoc financial analysis and special projects as needed.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
* Typically 4-7 years of relevant experience in FP&A, expense reporting, financial analysis, accounting, or a related corporate finance role.
* Solid understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cost allocations, and expense management concepts.
* Experience in the insurance or broader financial services industry is preferred; strong familiarity with insurance concepts is a plus.
* Advanced Excel skills, including experience building and maintaining financial models and working with large datasets.
* Proficiency with Power Query and/or Power BI is preferred.
* Experience with enterprise financial systems such as Oracle, SAP, Hyperion, or FCCS is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience improving reporting processes, automating recurring workflows, or increasing data quality and efficiency.
* Exposure to data analytics, automation, or AI-enabled solutions in a finance context is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts and analytical findings clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.
* Big Four or similar professional-services experience is a plus.

**Key Competencies**

* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned deliverables, and follow through to completion.
* Hands-on approach with the ability to work in the details while understanding the broader business context.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple deliverables and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive communication and effective cross-functional partnership.
* Intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new systems and tools.
* Continuous-improvement mindset focused on automation, efficiency, controls, and scalable processes.
* Comfort working with evolving processes, complex financial data, and changing business requirements.

**Role Scope**

This is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports or people-management responsibilities. The FP&A Analyst III is expected to independently execute assigned analyses and recurring processes, collaborate across functions, and provide reliable, decision-useful financial information to stakeholders.

What We Offer:

AmTrust Financial Services offers a competitive compensation package and excellent career advancement opportunities. Our benefits include Medical & Dental Plans, Life Insurance, including eligible spouses & children, Health Care Flexible Spending, Dependent Care, 401k Savings Plans, Paid Time Off.

AmTrust strives to create a diverse and inclusive culture where thoughts and ideas of all employees are appreciated and respected. This concept encompasses but is not limited to human differences with regard to race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, culture, religion or disabilities.

AmTrust values excellence and recognizes that by embracing the diverse backgrounds, skills, and perspectives of its workforce, it will sustain a competitive advantage and remain an employer of choice. Diversity is a business imperative, enabling us to attract, retain and develop the best talent available. We see diversity as more than just policies and practices. It is an integral part of who we are as a company, how we operate and how we see our future.

title: Financial Planning Analyst (FP&A)
description:
**Company Description**

Eataly is the world’s largest artisanal Italian food and beverage marketplace! Eataly is not a chain; each Eataly is different, with its own character and own theme – but all with the same aim... for our guests to:

* EAT authentic Italian food at our restaurants, cafés and to-go counters
* SHOP a selection of high-quality Italian, local and homemade products
* LEARN through our classes and our team’s product knowledge

  
**Job Description**

At Eataly the FP&A Analyst supports the FP&A Manager in their analysis and interpretation of data related to: Inventory Allocation, Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), Labor, Revenue, Operational Expenses, and the Profit and Loss Statement. The FP&A Analyst works closely with the FP&A Manager to provide analysis and execute changes as needed to maximize profitability and productivity.

Reports directly to the Sr Manager FP&A

* Supports the FP&A Manager with in-depth analysis related to costs, labor, margins, operational expenses, and sales performance on a daily basis
* Works with FP&A Manager to create reports tailored to the needs of the FP&A Department and Store Management
* Supports with inventory entry and overall inventory management
* Supports occasionally with FP&A-related activities in the store, which include inventory counts and invoice processing
* Collaborates with senior leaders to develop resourceful and creative approaches to improving efficiencies and profit margins to improve Return on Investment (ROI) in all areas of operations
* Educates and trains team members on processes and procedures, ensuring smooth adoption and compliance
* Supports FP&A Manager in training team members on Eataly’s in-house sales database, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Performs other duties as required or assigned

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics or Mathematics

  + Demonstrated success in financial modeling
  + Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  + Data-driven mindset
  + Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills preferred
  + Familiarity with databases, automation or business intelligence preferred
  + Passion for and interest in Italian food is a plus

  The annual compensation for this role is: $85,000 - $100,000

 **Additional Information**

**Benefits and Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* 401K with match or RRSP
* Bonus program
* Free family meal daily
* Discounts at Eataly
* Classes on products and Italian cuisine
* Referral bonus program
* and more!

It is the Company’s policy to not unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic made unlawful to consider by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Eataly also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also Eataly’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws regarding consideration of unemployment status, salary history, credit/bankruptcy history and criminal background/conviction history in making hiring decisions. Job Family: Accounting & Consolidation
  
Job Title: Kering Financial Analyst
  
Location: Wayne, NJ
  
  
A global, family-led luxury group, home to people whose passion and expertise nurture creative luxury Houses in couture, ready-to-wear, leather goods, décor, jewelry, eyewear and beauty: Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, Alexander McQueen, Brioni, Boucheron, Pomellato, Dodo, Qeelin and Ginori 1735, as well as Kering Eyewear and Kering Beauté. *Beyond core FP&A responsibilities, the Financial Analyst will gain broad exposure across the Americas region and be actively involved in* ***strategic and pilot finance projects*** *, contributing to the continuous improvement and transformation of finance processes.*

*You will join a* ***collaborative, proactive, and close-knit team*** *where knowledge sharing, open communication, and mutual support are part of our daily way of working. We value people who bring ideas, take initiative, and enjoy working together to find solutions and achieve common goals.*

*This role offers a strong combination of* ***financial expertise, business partnering, cross-functional collaboration, and project exposure*** *, providing an excellent opportunity to grow professionally and develop a comprehensive understanding of finance within a dynamic and international environment.*

* Support the budgeting and forecasting processes, including data submission, variance analysis, and commentary
* Monitor and control CapEx investments
* Support balance sheet reviews and related variance analysis in collaboration with the Accounting team
* Deliver monthly reporting for retail managers and operational functions (Facilities, Security, HR, Communications etc.) to ensure cost control
* Review accounting data to identify and resolve inaccuracies or discrepancies
* Handle ad hoc financial queries and perform additional analyses as required
* Support the implementation of the Finance Project
* Built us a strong relationship with the Brands managed

***WHO YOU ARE***

* Minimum 2 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, or Controlling within a multinational company or consulting firm

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, or Finance
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proven team-working capabilities
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Proficiency in Excel and BI tools for performance and KPI monitoring

annually

opportunities

state, and federal laws

------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. * Collaborate with Legal, Licensing, FP&A, IT, Operations, and external licensors to address audit inquiries and operational risks.

description:

Through our family of companies, CardWorks Financial Group tackles the complex challenges that larger financial institutions leave behind. We’re embedded throughout the credit card ecosystem as a lender, servicer, and merchant acquirer.

**Who We Are**

* Merrick Bank: The bank that builds
* CardWorks Servicing: One partner, total performance
* Carson Smithfield: Resolution with respect

With nearly 40 years of operating history, our track record is solid: disciplined in downturns and built to accelerate in recovery. The CardWorks Financial Group companies take precise approach in complex markets, as a top three non-prime focused general purpose card issuer and a top fifteen U.S. merchant acquirer.

Our team tackles the industry’s most complex credit and payment challenges. And we believe that excellent work starts with a team that feels supported, respected, and empowered to grow.

CardWorks Servicing, LLC provides end-to end operational servicing functions for credit cards, secured cards, and installment loans. We service consumer and small business loans across the credit spectrum and offers backup servicing and due diligence services to capital providers and trustees.

Founded in 1997, Merrick Bank is an FDIC®-insured financial institution headquartered in South Jordan, Utah, with over $10 billion in assets. A wholly owned subsidiary of CardWorks Financial Group, Merrick Bank serves roughly five million cardmembers and more than 100,000 merchant customers, offering credit cards, recreational loans, deposit accounts, merchant services and bank sponsorships to consumers and businesses.

Carson Smithfield, LLC provides a variety of post-charge-off debt recovery services, including digital self-service, IVR, live agent, and external agency management.

**Position Summary and Role Impact:**  
The VP, Controller, Head of Financial Reporting and Consolidation, is responsible for overseeing the company’s financial reporting, financial consolidation, technical accounting, equity and compensation accounting. This role ensures the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial statements and external disclosures in accordance with U.S. GAAP and applicable requirements.

The position oversees monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting, including financial consolidation, equity-based compensation, payroll and benefits accounting and external audits. The role also maintains effective accounting policies, internal controls and financial reporting systems. Working closely with Accounting, FP&A, HR, Legal, SOX, Internal Audit, and external auditors, this individual will strengthen financial reporting controls, drive operational excellence and continuously improve the company’s accounting and reporting processes.

**Essential Functions:**

**SEC and External Financial Reporting**

* Lead the preparation, review, and timely delivery of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and external deliverables.
* Oversee U.S. GAAP financial statements, footnotes, and supporting financial disclosures, including SEC filings where applicable.
* Manage quarterly external reviews and annual financial statement audits, coordinating deliverables and resolving audit matters.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness and consistency of financial statements and external financial communications.
* Manage reporting calendars, disclosure checklists, filing documentation, and cross-functional review processes.
* Coordinate with Legal, external auditors, and internal stakeholders on financial reporting requirements and disclosures.

**Financial Consolidation and Corporate Accounting**

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial consolidation processes, including intercompany eliminations and consolidated financial statement preparation.
* Ensure accurate recording of transactions and consolidation adjustments in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
* Review account reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting schedules for significant and complex accounting areas.
* Establish and maintain effective financial close and consolidation procedures.
* Drive improvements in close/ consolidation timelines, reporting accuracy and process scalability.

**Payroll, Benefits, and Incentive Compensation Accounting**

* Oversee accounting and financial reporting for payroll, employee benefits, bonuses and other incentive compensation programs.
* Ensure appropriate recognition, accrual, classification, and disclosure of compensation-related expenses and liabilities under U.S. GAAP.
* Maintain effective controls over compensation accounting, including completeness and accuracy of related financial information.

**Equity and Equity Compensation Accounting, Reporting, and Administration**

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa will accept applications for this role until at least 11-11-2026

**Job Description**

Role Summary:  
Visa’s Global Corporate Development and Mergers and Acquisitions (CDMA) team forms part of the Global function which is collectively responsible for helping shape Visa’s strategy by identifying industry trends, maintaining relationships with relevant external partners, as well as sourcing, negotiating, structuring, and executing strategic acquisitions/investments across all of Visa's geographies and businesses. As the payment landscape evolves, the Corporate Development & M&A team works with regional and business executives as well as corporate strategy to evaluate, analyze, and prioritize Visa’s inorganic strategic ambitions. Corporate Development & M&A team is a key partner of the business executives and is central to shaping the M&A and Investment agenda for Visa.

The Senior Manager, Global Corporate Development will provide support in identifying, evaluating, and executing public and private company acquisitions, joint ventures, minority investments, and other strategic initiatives. A strong candidate will benefit from payments industry familiarity and proven strategic thinking. Candidates should have had experience working on multiple transactions – including all elements: target identification through to closing, and have a firm understanding of a deal process as well as typical points of friction in a transaction. They must be skilled at driving cross-functional diligence teams through detailed processes without losing focus on what truly matters. They must be collaborative by nature and be able to build quality internal and external relationships.

Responsibilities

* Support Visa’s growth strategy through identification, assessment, and execution of potential mergers, acquisitions, investments and joint ventures
* Investigate industry trends and specific opportunities for growth within Visa’s existing businesses and expansion into new areas, as well as absorb information and help form a persuasive point of view grounded in data, and articulate this view effectively with a variety of stakeholders, including executive management
* Conduct rigorous analyses, including valuation and business case modeling, to provide detailed guidance and insight regarding potential acquisitions and investments
* Partner with Corporate Development & M&A Leaders as well as the Business on strategy development and realization, and identify corporate development opportunities in a progressive, systematic and routine fashion
* Support business unit coverage to maintain an ongoing flow of ideas aligned with their objectives
* Assist with the tracking of pipeline, market outreach and deal flow for ongoing discussions with key business sponsors and stakeholders

* Identify clear rationales and risks associated with proposed transactions through spoken and written communications with key stakeholders, considering Visa’s overall interests
* Build presentations for Visa's senior leadership that convey effective narrative, outline strategic trade-offs, and drive executive decision-making
* Support the Visa Integration/Separation team on post-close planning and execution
* Assist with Visa's global industry engagement and deal relationships with Investment Banking, PE, and VC firms. Serve as a Visa interface with partner companies and act as a point of coordination for investment and other activities with these companies.
* Contribute to all of Visa’s M&A activities, including the development of fellow team members, Corporate Development and M&A practices, and company culture. Develop working relationships grounded in trust, collaboration, respect, and open assistance with all teammates
* Some travel is expected as part of the role.

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.

* B.S. in Finance or Accounting or equivalent required.

title: FP&A Manager
description:
Bessemer Trust is seeking a Vice President, Manager – Fee Revenue Financial Planning & Analysis, to join the FP&A organization within Finance.

This position will have primary responsibility for the day-to-day management of the firm's fee revenue planning, forecasting, reporting and analysis. The role will develop a deep understanding of the drivers of fee revenue, including client assets, market performance, client flows, pricing, product and service mix, and other underlying business trends, and will translate those drivers into clear financial insight for senior management.

The VP, FP&A Manager will serve as a key finance partner across the organization, helping to ensure that fee revenue forecasts and related management reporting are accurate, well supported, and aligned with business expectations. The role will also directly manage a team of Fee Revenue FP&A analysts and associates supporting revenue activities and will play a leading role in strengthening revenue analytics, models, processes, systems, and controls.

**Responsibilities:**

**Fee Revenue Planning, Forecasting & Analysis**

* Lead the day-to-day management of fee revenue forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning.
* Develop a deep understanding of key fee revenue drivers, including assets, market performance, client flows, pricing, and organic growth.
* Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess revenue impacts from changes in key business and market assumptions.
* Serve as a primary FP&A partner on fee revenue matters, collaborating across Finance, Fee Operations, Client & Wealth Advisory, Investment Management, Operations, and other key stakeholders.

**Revenue Reporting & Executive Insights**

* Own recurring fee reporting and analysis for FP&A and senior management.
* Lead and support preparation of Executive Committee and Board materials on fee performance, forecasts, and long-range planning.
* Analyze revenue performance and key variance drivers, translating results into actionable executive insights.
* Ensure revenue analyses and supporting materials are accurate, reconciled, and senior management ready.
* Partner with business teams to understand underlying activity, validate assumptions, and strengthen revenue forecasting.
* Partner with firm leadership on special strategic projects and analyses for the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors.

**Client Flows & Revenue Driver Analysis**

* Enhance analytical frameworks linking client activity and asset flows to fee revenue.
* Analyze new business, existing client activity, closed business, retention, and other flow measures to assess fee revenue impacts.
* Partner with business and Finance teams to develop assumptions related to client growth, retention, pricing, and revenue realization.
* Provide greater transparency into the relationship between organic growth, markets, assets, and fee revenue.

**Revenue Models, Systems & Process Improvement**

* Own and enhance fee models, methodologies, dashboards, and analytical tools to strengthen forecasting and visibility into key revenue drivers.
* Strengthen documentation, controls, reconciliations, and review processes supporting revenue forecasting and reporting.
* Partner with Finance Technology to enhance revenue planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytics across OneStream and other Finance platforms.

**Team Management and Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop FP&A analysts and associates supporting fee revenue.
* Prioritize, allocate work, and ensure timely delivery of recurring and ad hoc analyses.
* Review team output and maintain high standards for accuracy, analytical rigor, and executive communication.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA preferred.
* Approximately 10+ years of relevant FP&A, corporate finance or related experience.
* Financial services experience preferred, including banking, wealth management, private equity, or venture capital.
* Demonstrated experience leading forecasting, financial planning, management reporting, and long-range planning.
* Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to connect business drivers to financial performance and translate results into actionable insights.
* Proven ability to identify key trends, risks and performance drivers within complex financial data.
* Strong executive communication and business partnering skills, with experience working across functions and with senior stakeholders.

* Ability to operate independently, successfully manage direct reports, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality work under recurring deadlines.

title: Corporate Controller
description:
**Open role in MTP Office locations, including New York, and Chicago**

**Visa Sponsorship** is not available for this position, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without requiring employer sponsorship.

  

**Role Overview**

The Corporate Controller owns accounting, consolidation, and financial reporting for Meet The People's 13 legal entities across the United States and Canada. This role produces one accurate, timely set of consolidated financials from a multi-entity, multi-currency group, and owns the close, internal controls, and the external audit. As the group's corporate accounting lead, the Controller sets the accounting policies, close standards, and controls that every pillar and entity finance team follows.

The Controller will also serve as interim head of finance for one of MTP's agencies, spending roughly 30–40% of their time running that agency's finance function and developing its Director of Finance to take on the full role.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** (Other duties may be assigned)

**Consolidation and Multi-entity Accounting**

* Consolidate all 13 US and Canadian entities into accurate, timely consolidated financial statements under US GAAP.
* Run intercompany accounting, including transactions, cross-charges, reconciliations, and elimination entries across all entities.
* Maintain a consistent chart of accounts, accounting policies, and close procedures across every entity.
* Set group-wide close calendars, reporting packages, and review standards for pillar and entity finance teams, and review their submissions before consolidation.
* Build scalable consolidation processes and tools that can absorb new entities as MTP grows.

**Close and Financial Reporting**

* Run the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for all entities on a defined, predictable calendar.
* Prepare consolidated and entity-level financial statements, including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.
* Oversee transactional accounting across entities; own balance sheet integrity, including intercompany transaction reconciliations.
* Partner with operations, HR, and IT so transactional data flows cleanly and accurately into the accounting records.
* Provide the CFO and leadership with accurate actuals, account analysis, and variance explanations for management reporting.

**Internal Controls and Accounting Policy**

* Establish, document, and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Own the internal control environment and risk assessment over financial reporting.
* Oversee technical accounting, including revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), and business combinations (ASC 805).

**Audit and Tax**

* Coordinate the annual external audit and act as the auditors' primary day-to-day contact; resolve audit findings and implement corrective actions promptly.
* Coordinate US and Canadian tax compliance with external tax advisors, including income tax, sales tax, GST/HST, and 1099 information reporting.
* Support the CFO on tax planning and in relationships with tax advisors, banks, and other financial partners.

**Acquisitions and Integration**

* Support financial due diligence for acquisitions if needed, focusing on the quality of the target's accounting, controls, and close.
* Run accounting integration of acquired companies, including purchase accounting and opening balance sheets.
* Account for earnouts and contingent consideration, including periodic remeasurement.
* Bring new entities into the consolidation, close calendar, and control environment quickly.

**Interim Agency Head of Finance**

* Serve as interim head of finance for one of MTP's pillars, overseeing the pillar's accounting, close, and financial reporting until the existing director of finance is ready for the role.
* Deliver accurate, on-time monthly financial statements and reporting packages for the agency leadership.
* Partner with agency leadership on financial performance, margins, and client profitability, and oversee billing, collections, and payables.
* Mentor and develop existing Director of Finance, coaching on close discipline, reconciliations, technical accounting, and reporting quality.

**Team Leadership and Systems**

* Own the general ledger, consolidation, and close tools for HoldCo, including system access and controls, and drive ERP optimization, automation, and process standardization across entities.
* Support the CFO in building finance succession and development plans, and drive a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with the CFO and IT on financial systems strategy and data integrity

**Qualifications** -To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.
* 5+ years in a Controller, Assistant Controller, or equivalent senior accounting leadership role.
* Proven experience consolidating 5+ legal entities, including at least one entity outside the US.
* Hands-on experience with intercompany accounting, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
* Experience in a corporate or group controller role overseeing the accounting of multiple business units or pillars.
* Experience leading external audits and partnering closely with a CFO.
* Track record of mentoring and developing finance leaders, not only staff accountants.
* Experience leading the finance function of an operating business or agency, partnering directly with its leadership.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep knowledge of US GAAP, consolidations, and financial reporting.
* Strong working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606), including principal-versus-agent considerations common in media and agency businesses.
* Strong knowledge of internal controls, compliance, and financial governance.
* Understanding of US and Canadian tax compliance for a cross-border group.
* Advanced ERP and consolidation systems skills, with advanced Excel.

**Skills and Leadership Competencies**

* Builds, develops, and retains high-performing accounting teams.
* Hands-on and detail-oriented; comfortable doing the work as well as reviewing it.
* Delivers under tight deadlines while managing multiple priorities.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, change, and a growing, acquisitive organization.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Builds working relationships across all levels of the organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in marketing, advertising, media, or professional services agencies.
* Public accounting experience with a national or regional firm.
* Experience in private equity-backed organizations.
* Experience with post-acquisition accounting integration, including purchase accounting and earnouts.
* Experience with cross-border US/Canada operations.
* Systems: MediaOcean, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

**Education and Licensure**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.
* Active CPA (or Canadian CPA) required.
* MBA or master's degree in Accounting or Finance preferred.

Equinox seeks a dynamic and highly motivated Senior Manager to join our Treasury team. As Senior Manager, Treasury, you will lead corporate cash management, liquidity planning, and financial risk mitigation and hedging, while ensuring an optimal capital structure and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate will have excellent financial, analytical, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. The Treasury team works cross functionally to support all aspects of the organization - this individual should be a self-starter who is eager to roll up their sleeves, dive into details and drive decision making through financial analysis. This role reports to our Vice President of Finance and is based at our Park Avenue headquarters in New York City. If interested and qualified, please apply directly to the role online.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily cash operations including movement of cash between business units, wire transfers, optimization of debt costs and bank fees, and cash reporting.
* Lead short-term and long-term cash forecasts.
* Manage financial risk, including interest rate, foreign exchange, and commodity exposures, and lead hedging strategies to mitigate exposure.
* Maintain relationships with banks and financial institutions; manage debt facilities and lender compliance requirements.
* Provide valuable input on capital structure, investment strategies, and treasury transformation projects.
* Manage the investment of excess cash and short-term investment portfolios, balancing yield, liquidity, and capital preservation.
* Assist with financial due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, and capital fundraising.
* Partner with FP&A and business leaders to support financial planning, budgeting, and strategic decision-making with treasury insights.
* Lead system automation and efficiency in treasury tasks.
* Ensure all treasury activities comply with internal policies and controls, and regulatory standards.
* Mentor high-performing Treasury team, fostering a culture of analytics and collaboration.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or Accounting is required. MBA or CTP preferred.
* 8+ years of corporate treasury experience, preferably in a multinational organization, with 3+ years in a management role.
* Investment banking experience is a plus.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and treasury management systems (TMS).
* Proven leadership skills and ability to manage a small team.
* Proven analytical, financial modeling and presentation skills with the ability to conduct detailed analyses, tell the story through data, and effectively summarize actionable recommendations.
* Must be a proactive self-starter with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and responsibilities.
* Results-oriented with strong attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Must be a team player who understands the importance of the role as a key support function to the organization

We're seeking an energetic, intellectually curious Analyst to join the Portfolio Construction Strategy team — the front-office arm of OPC — to help shape how advisors across the U.S. Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management build, review, and refine client portfolios.

OPC is a major initiative for the business, with a mission to elevate portfolio construction as a core differentiator of the Private Bank and Wealth Management and equip advisors to build portfolios aligned to each client's plan, grounded in our principles, and focused on after-tax outcomes. The group is focused on three pillars — establishing portfolio construction principles, tying strategy to portfolio action, and providing advisors with customized guidance they can scale — and operates across the Private Bank and U.S. Wealth Management, supporting 7,000+ advisors and more than $750B in investment assets. Our north star is embedding our advice and methodologies into the AI-powered tools (ConnectWealth and Portfolio Builder) that scale portfolio advice across every advisor.

You'll work alongside senior Strategists and partner closely with Global Investment Strategy, Investments Research, Managed Investments, Due Diligence, and regional Investments & Advice leaders — gaining a broad, cross-asset view of how portfolios actually get built through an after-tax lens at one of the world's leading wealth managers.

The Portfolio Construction Strategy team is the advisor-facing engine of OPC. Working with a product-agnostic lens — across public and private assets, taxable and tax-exempt portfolios, and discretionary, advisory and brokerage accounts — we help advisors answer the questions that matter most for client portfolios: how to build a strategic asset allocation, how to deliver on client preferences such as high income or concentrated-equity diversification, how to size high-conviction ideas alongside a core portfolio, and how to drive tax-efficiency across the whole portfolio.

title: Head of Finance Performance Management - Rail Infrastructure
description:
**Position Overview**

Siemens Mobility North America seeks an experienced finance leader to head Finance and Performance Management (FPM) for its Rail Infrastructure (RI) business. The role provides an independent, forward-looking view of performance, serves as a trusted sparring partner to RI and Finance leadership, and connects the business unit with North America and global stakeholders.

You will lead the RI FPM team and own the coordination, consolidation, analysis and communication of financial performance, combining strong governance with commercial insight, constructive challenge and pragmatic decision support in a complex project and product environment.

**What You Will Accomplish**

* Drive fact-based performance management, translating financial and operational data into a clear view of results, outlook, risks, opportunities and required actions.
* Act as an independent, solution-oriented partner who challenges assumptions and explains trade-offs without taking over operational ownership.
* Build a coherent RI financial narrative that links drivers, financial statements and management priorities across segments and stakeholders.
* Develop a high-performing, collaborative FPM team that balances business proximity with common North America standards and continuous capability building.
* Advance process harmonization, digitalization, analytics and responsible AI to improve finance quality, speed and productivity.

**Key Responsibilities**

Business Partnership and Performance Management

* Serve as principal FPM partner to RI leadership and the primary RI interface to North America regional and global finance.
* Monitor key financial and operational indicators to spot trends, deviations, risks and opportunities early and turn them into decision-relevant insights.
* Objectively challenge forecasts, budgets, business cases and assumptions; develop scenarios, sensitivities and fact-based recommendations.
* Deliver concise executive analyses explaining what changed, why it matters, what remains uncertain and where action is needed.

Planning, Forecasting, Reporting and Financial Integrity

* Lead the RI annual budget, monthly forecast and management reporting processes, from calendars and inputs through consolidation, review, commentary and submission.
* Ensure a complete, accurate and consistent view of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, with transparent bridges between actuals, forecast, budget and prior outlook.
* Challenge the plausibility of business and project inputs, investigate unusual entries and variances, and make material risks, opportunities and adjustments visible in the outlook.
* Partner with Accounting, Commercial Project Management, Operations and others to align close impacts, assumptions and the financial storyline, while keeping accountability for source data and business decisions clear.
* Escalate material performance, cash, balance-sheet, compliance or control issues promptly, with the evidence decision makers need.

Governance, Process Excellence and Digitalization

* Reinforce finance governance, internal-control and reporting requirements; support audit readiness and documentation of significant assumptions and judgments.
* Clarify responsibilities and interfaces across FPM, the business, Accounting, CPM, Operations and central functions to avoid duplication, ownership gaps and “shadow” controlling structures.
* Drive common North America FPM standards and best practices, allowing fit-for-purpose differences for RI business models and segments.
* Sponsor simplification, automation, analytics and digital-finance initiatives, including SAC, SAP, standardized templates and responsible AI-enabled workflows.
* Regularly assess the value, effort and control implications of recurring reports and processes, prioritizing improvements in insight, reliability or productivity.

Leadership and Talent Development

* Lead, coach and develop a diverse finance team with clear priorities, quality standards, responsibilities and development goals.
* Foster trust, candid communication, accountability, collaboration and continuous learning across locations and organizational boundaries.
* Balance business support, governance and capacity, focusing resources on material topics and ensuring resilient coverage of critical recurring processes.
* Contribute to the North America FPM leadership team and the OneFPM agenda, including talent development, succession planning and cross-business collaboration.

Scope and Accountability

FPM owns financial transparency, process coordination, consolidation, independent challenge and management insight; business and functional owners remain accountable for operational plans, source assumptions, corrective actions and final decisions. The Head of FPM RI keeps these interfaces explicit, surfaces material issues and ensures temporary support does not become a permanent transfer of ownership.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 8+ years of progressive experience in controlling, FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial project management, or similar, including meaningful leadership responsibility.
* Proven ability to lead budgeting, forecasting, performance reporting and executive reviews in a complex matrix organization.
* Strong grasp of P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow interdependencies and how project, operational and commercial drivers shape financial outcomes.
* Excellent analytical judgment; able to distinguish facts, estimates and hypotheses, challenge assumptions and make uncertainty explicit.
* Executive-level communication skills, turning complex data into concise, decision-oriented messages for regional and international stakeholders.
* Proven people leader who coaches experienced professionals, sets direction and builds constructive relationships across functions and hierarchies.
* High integrity, resilience and sound judgment; able to prioritize and deliver reliable results under competing deadlines.
* Advanced proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and analytics tools; experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP, data visualization, automation or AI-enabled finance workflows is an advantage.
* Experience in project-driven, infrastructure, transportation, or industrial businesses preferred.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi’s Clean Energy Finance (CEF) team is seeking a candidate to join the origination desk’s in-business portfolio management team to support its tax equity and tax credit transfer mandates.

  
  

**About CEF**
-------------

The Clean Energy Finance (“CEF”) Group provides comprehensive and customized solutions, including Hybrid Tax Equity Financing, to Citi’s clients in the clean energy and energy efficiency sectors. CEF has extensive expertise in originating, structuring, and executing financings for various renewable energy & sustainable technologies, including:

* Onshore and Offshore Wind (Utility Scale)

* Waste-to-Energy

* Biomass

* Fuel Cells

* Hydrogen

* Energy Efficiency

-------------------

CEF seeks to hire a full-time Portfolio Management Analyst to assist in overseeing and tracking the CEF portfolio of renewable energy loans, leases, warehouse facilities, and tax equity positions that CEF holds and manages on Citi’s balance sheet. Partnering closely with CEF transaction execution teams, financial controllers, tax department, Citi Risk Management teams, outside consultants and engineers to manage consent/waiver and other ad-hoc requests from client/sponsors asset managers, skillfully balancing the needs of the client and Citi’s risk appetite

This role combines financial analysis, matter budgeting, and direct partner support, and will own and help maintain pricing processes, tools, and databases. The Senior Analyst will support the capture and upkeep of pricing data and insights so they can be leveraged effectively across the firm.

This is a collaborative, hands-on role for a commercially minded professional who can balance analytical rigor with strong communication, process management, and strong follow-through.

  

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

  

Pricing & Partner Support

  

* Collaborate with partners to develop and evaluate fee proposals, budgets, and alternative fee arrangements (AFAs).
* Independently provide financial modeling and analysis to support client negotiations and business development opportunities.
* Draft first-pass fee estimates from selected precedents within familiar practice areas.
* Assist partners in preparing and securing approvals from the firm’s Finance Committee by supplying data-driven insights and business cases.
Present findings to the team and explain the analysis behind them; educate and advise partners on pricing trends, client expectations, and firm guidelines.  

  

Financial Analysis & Tracking

  

* Build and monitor matter budgets, analyze budget to actual variances and drivers of performance, providing updates and insights to partners and leadership.
* Track fee agreements and matter performance against expectations, highlighting trends and risks.
* Prepare reports and dashboards that present pricing outcomes, client behaviors, and profitability metrics.
Use AI-assisted analytics to accelerate data pulls, draft estimates, and flag anomalies in routine work.  

  

Process Support

  

* Support pricing processes and partner requests by producing accurate, timely analyses and work product.
* Coordinate with the Rates & Compliance, Finance, and Client Development and Engagement teams to ensure consistent inputs and high-quality output for partners and practice groups.
Help document and follow efficient workflows, ensuring consistency and scalability of pricing support across the firm.  

  

Pricing Tools & Database Support

  

* Own recurring data pulls and datasets end to end, and maintain and validate the accuracy of the firm’s pricing databases, tools, and templates.
* Ensure pricing data is captured consistently, enabling robust analysis and reporting.
* Partner with IT and other Finance teams to enhance tools and processes that improve efficiency and client service.
* Build, test, and maintain AI-enabled pricing workflows, such as automated data pulls, first-draft fee estimates, budget-to-actual variance checks, and anomaly flagging, that other team members can adopt.
* Use Claude and Harvey to analyze and summarize matter data, research precedent matters and engagement terms, draft pricing narratives and proposal content, and prototype analyses and tools, applying prompt design and iteration to produce reliable, repeatable results.
Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy and fit against source data and pricing expertise, document quality checks and limitations, and ensure compliance with client confidentiality and firm AI policies; pilot new AI use cases and train partners and colleagues on approved tools and workflows.  

  

Best Practices & Process Improvement

  

* Improve templates and process steps, record the changes, and support the creation and roll-out of pricing playbooks, guidelines, and templates.
* Drive adoption of consistent approaches to scoping, budgeting, and fee negotiations.
Contribute to firm-wide initiatives that improve value delivery, efficiency, and financial outcomes.  

  

Client Engagement Support

  

* Play an active role in RFPs, client negotiations, and fee discussions.
Provide strategic support in creating and presenting value-driven, competitive proposals.  

  
  

**Education**

  

Required

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or related field.  

  

**Skills & Experience**

* 4-6 years of experience in pricing, financial analysis, or related roles within professional services (law firm experience preferred).
* Proficiency in MS Office suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of financial metrics such as realization, leverage, effective rate, and margin.
* Hands-on experience building with generative AI tools, such as Claude and Harvey, including prompt design, workflow automation, and light scripting or low-code tools.

* Ensure customer experience is represented in commercial decisions, using customer insight to test whether customers understand the prices we communicate.
* Present data-driven insights and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional partners.
* Share learnings with, and borrow practices from, peers in other brands.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

J.P. Morgan's public finance investor marketing team is Wall Street's premier sell-side desk analyst team. In our role, we (1) make credit trading recommendations to the high yield and high grade traders; (2) develop credit marketing strategies for new issue municipal bond sales; (3) assess credit structures and documentation to determine marketability. Our issuer clients include a wide range of prominent tax-exempt and taxable borrowers, including the nation's largest hospital systems, transportation entities (airports, toll roads, transit, bridges, etc), utilities (water/sewer and electric), not-for-profit universities, states and municipalities as well as a range of project finance transactions. Investor clients include domestic and overseas based mutual funds, asset managers, banks, hedge funds and insurance companies.

As an Analyst in the group, you will quickly be expected to present actionable trade ideas formulated by your independent research and analysis. This will require mastering the reading and interpretation of complex legal documents and connecting that information to your determination of the financial feasibility of projects and the creditworthiness of the borrower. Additionally, you will perform data analysis, provide credit support for secondary trading and the primary market syndicate desk, assist in the development of marketing strategies, write independent credit reviews and pitch proposals, and help facilitate issuer roadshows. All aspects of the position are quantitative and require fast-paced critical thinking based on analysis of financial positions and trends, news and events, and relative value. The group is entirely based in New York City. The position also requires regular interaction with various types of issuer and investor clients, and the development of these relationships over time.

Job Responsibilities:

* Read and interpret rating agency publications as well as muni issuer disclosure documents
* Develop credit research based trade ideas
* Draft credit notes, analyze comparables and update desk on engagement for primary market bond sales
* Perform ad hoc research assignments relevant to sector credit themes
* Develop technology tools to streamline analysis and automate ongoing desk tasks
* Maintain an interest in municipal bond investing and municipal issuers

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Strong knowledge or interest in public finance and the municipal bond market (see above for sample clients)
* Up to 3 years' experience in financial markets (rating agency, investment bank, asset manager, municipal financial advisor or issuer)
* Analytical Skills: Financial statement analysis (accounting) and quantitative skills. Able to build, interpret, and manipulate credit models. Able to synthesize data to identify trends and conclusions. Read and interpret complex legal documents.

The Campaign Finance Board is a nonpartisan, independent city agency that empowers New Yorkers to have a greater impact on their elections. Our mission is to make local democracy more open, transparent, and equitable by removing barriers to participation.

The Senior Manager will also play a key role in ensuring best practices are embedded firm-wide, and that pricing data and insights are captured, maintained, and leveraged effectively.

  

This is a collaborative, hands-on leadership role for a commercially minded professional who can balance analytical rigor with strong communication, process management, and people leadership, and who is comfortable influencing at the most senior levels of the firm.

  

**Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities**

Pricing & Partner Support

  

* Collaborate with partners to develop and evaluate fee proposals, budgets, and alternative fee arrangements

* Provide sophisticated financial modeling and analysis to support client negotiations and business development opportunities.

* Support partners in the preparation of business cases and obtaining approvals from the firm’s Finance Committee by supplying data-driven insights and recommendations.

* Serve as a trusted advisor to partners, practice group leaders and firm leadership on pricing trends, client expectations, risk-sharing structures, and firm guidelines.

Act as the escalation point for the most complex or sensitive pricing matters and exercise sound judgment on risk, profitability and client relationship considerations.

THE AGENCY
  
The Department of City Planning (DCP) plans for the future of New York City, working to create thriving and dynamic neighborhoods with access to housing and jobs, resilient infrastructure, and a vibrant public realm. The Department engages communities to develop inclusive plans, expand housing access and economic opportunity, and plans for long-term sustainability.
  
  
DCP supports the City Planning Commission in its annual review of hundreds of land use applications. The Department also advises on citywide strategic and capital planning, analyzes data, conducts policy analysis, and creates open data and civic engagement tools.
  
  
The Department of City Planning offers staff meaningful opportunities to help shape the future of New York City and address some of its most pressing challenges. The Department values public service, collaboration, and creativity, and supports professional development. Learn more about DCP at www.nyc.gov/planning.
  
  
THE DIVISION
  
The Population Division is responsible for the compilation, analysis, and dissemination of census and related federal, state and local data for city agencies, local communities, and the media. It is the city’s hub of expertise in census data analyses and dissemination. Within the Department, the Population Division provides data for a variety of local and citywide planning initiatives, environmental review analyses, and capital planning strategies. The division also provides other city agencies and outside organizations with data and demographic expertise to address questions involving needs assessment, program planning and targeting, and policy formulation. This includes the development of current population estimates and population projections. The Population Division also does much to support a complete and accurate Census enumeration, including research into missing addresses used to update Census Bureau files.
  
  
THE POSITION
  
The Population Division is looking for a quantitatively-oriented person, with keen observation skills and a passion for exploring the streets of New York, to assist in 2030 Census preparations. The work involves compiling, mapping, and analyzing address data along with much in-field data verification.
  
  
The successful candidate will:
  

* Assist with 2030 Census preparations by conducting research into hidden housing
* Create, manage, and verify address and group quarters facilities lists from administrative data sources, such as the Department of Buildings, Department of Finance, and other city agencies and organizations
* Conduct extensive field research in neighborhoods across the city to document the existence of low-visibility/hard-to-enumerate housing
* Conduct extensive in-office research to support the verification of low-visibility/hard-to-enumerate housing using GIS and other software
* Conduct outreach efforts related to identifying and documenting hard-to-enumerate housing
* Assist in generating charts, tables, and other visualizations
* Perform thorough quality assurance vetting of address data and other geographic files

* Facility in analyzing and managing large datasets
* Familiarity with New York City neighborhoods and comfort navigating across the five boroughs
* Willingness to work in slightly challenging weather conditions and an ability to walk hours at a time while operating a tablet computer
* Ability to work both cooperatively and independently
* GIS experience, particularly ArcGIS Online, and proficiency with Microsoft Excel
* Working knowledge of Spanish, Chinese, or other languages commonly spoken in New York City a plus
* Coursework in geography, demography, other social sciences, or statistics also a plus

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
**Overview**
------------

Mailchimp is a leading marketing automation platform that empowers millions of businesses to grow through powerful, easy-to-use marketing and messaging solutions. As we expand beyond email into omnichannel customer engagement, Messaging is at the forefront of Mailchimp's growth strategy, helping businesses connect with their customers through SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and other emerging communication channels.

Come join the **Mailchimp Product Data Science team as a Staff Data Scientist supporting Messaging**, one of our most exciting and strategically important growth areas. We are looking for a creative, business-minded problem solver who is passionate about leveraging data science to unlock customer value, accelerate product innovation, and drive measurable business impact.

As a **Staff Data Scientist,** you will serve as a **senior individual contributor and strategic thought partner** to Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Product Marketing leaders. You will tackle complex, high-impact business problems across the messaging customer journey—from adoption and engagement to monetization, retention, and revenue growth. Your expertise in advanced analytics, experimentation, causal inference, machine learning, and automation will be instrumental in identifying growth opportunities, shaping product strategy, and influencing investment decisions.

This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape the future of Mailchimp's omnichannel messaging strategy. You will lead strategic research, develop scalable data products and measurement frameworks, and translate complex insights into actionable recommendations that influence product roadmaps and accelerate business outcomes. Beyond individual projects, you will help elevate data science capabilities across teams, break down organizational silos, and establish analytical approaches that scale across the broader Mailchimp ecosystem.

**Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Data Partnership & Influence:** Serve as a trusted data science partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Product Marketing leaders, shaping Mailchimp's omnichannel messaging strategy across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and emerging channels. Influence product roadmaps, investment priorities, and business decisions through data-driven insights.
* **Product Strategy & Revenue Growth:** Identify, size, and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities across the messaging customer journey, including acquisition, adoption, activation, engagement, monetization, and retention. Translate ambiguous business challenges into rigorous analytical frameworks and actionable recommendations that accelerate customer and revenue growth.
* **Advanced Analytics & Causal Inference:** Lead complex, end-to-end analytical investigations using advanced statistics, SQL, Python, machine learning, and causal inference. Design and evaluate A/B tests and quasi-experiments (e.g., difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic control) to establish causal relationships, quantify incremental impact, and guide product decisions.
* **Measurement Strategy & Experimentation:** Develop scalable measurement frameworks and define success metrics to evaluate messaging product performance, customer outcomes, and business impact. Champion experimentation best practices and analytical rigor to enable faster, more confident decision-making.
* **Scalable Data Products & AI Innovation:** Build reusable analytical frameworks, automated insights, opportunity-sizing tools, and self-service data products that democratize access to insights and scale Data Science impact. Leverage modern AI/ML techniques and AI-assisted tools to accelerate analytical workflows and improve organizational productivity.
* **Predictive Modeling & Customer Intelligence:** Apply machine learning, predictive modeling, and customer segmentation to uncover behavioral patterns, identify growth opportunities, and optimize messaging adoption, engagement, and customer lifetime value.
* **Data Quality & Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Data Engineering and platform teams to improve data instrumentation, quality, reliability, and accessibility. Break down organizational silos by developing consistent metrics, sharing learnings, and scaling analytical solutions across messaging channels and the broader Mailchimp ecosystem.
* **Executive Communication & Technical Leadership:** Translate complex analytical findings into compelling, actionable narratives for technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including senior leadership. Provide technical thought leadership, mentor peers, and elevate the organization's standards for data-driven decision-making, experimentation, and innovation.

**Qualifications**

* **8+ years of experience** in Data Science, Product Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline, with a demonstrated track record of driving measurable customer, product, and revenue impact in SaaS, marketing technology, or digital products.
* **Deep expertise in advanced analytics, experimentation, and causal inference**, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic control, regression discontinuity). Demonstrated ability to select and apply rigorous methodologies to ambiguous business problems and quantify incremental impact.
* **Strong foundation in predictive modeling and machine learning**, including customer segmentation, propensity modeling, churn prediction, with experience translating models and insights into actionable product and business decisions.
* **Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python** (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels), with hands-on experience analyzing large, complex datasets, developing statistical models, and building scalable analytical solutions.
* **Strong product and business acumen**, with experience identifying and sizing growth opportunities, evaluating product performance, and influencing strategies related to customer acquisition, adoption, engagement, monetization, and retention.
* **Experience building scalable data products and analytical frameworks**, including automated insights, opportunity-sizing tools, and self-service solutions that improve decision-making and extend Data Science impact beyond individual analyses.
* **Working fluency with modern AI tools and workflows**, including LLM-based coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude) and AI-assisted analytics, with the ability to accelerate analytical development while maintaining high standards for accuracy, reproducibility, and rigor.
* **Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and influence cross-functional stakeholders**, independently leading complex analytical initiatives and translating insights into strategic recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.
* **Exceptional communication and data storytelling skills**, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Marketing.
* **Bachelor's degree** in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **messaging, marketing automation, communications platforms, or omnichannel customer engagement**, including SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, or email marketing.
* Experience with **SaaS monetization, usage-based pricing, product-led growth, and customer lifecycle optimization**.
* Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, establishing analytical best practices, and scaling data science capabilities across teams.
