We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.

**About the Role**

Within is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to own and close high-value deals within all verticals across Software, Financial Services, Retail, Industrial, etc.. You’ll be the tip of the spear - building a pipeline from scratch, running executive-level sales cycles, and converting Fortune-2000 institutions into WithIn customers. This is a full-cycle closing role: you win when deals close and customers realize value.

You’ll own the entire sales motion from first outreach through signed contract, partnering with Solutions Consultants, Marketing, and Customer Success to qualify opportunities, navigate complex buying committees, and build business cases that resonate with VP, SVP, EVP, and C-Suite buyers.

This role requires someone who can walk into a boardroom of senior financial executives and command credibility from the first handshake. You’re as comfortable building a territory plan from a blank sheet of paper as you are negotiating a six-figure enterprise contract with a CFO. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and treat every deal like your own business.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and own a territory of accounts from the ground up — sourcing pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive networking, industry events, and strategic partnerships
* Run full-cycle enterprise sales processes targeting VP, SVP, EVP, and C-Suite decision-makers, from initial discovery and qualification through negotiation and close
* Develop deep domain expertise for AI workflows to position Within’s platform as a transformative solution.
* Craft and deliver compelling executive-level business cases, ROI analyses, and proposals tailored to the specific pain points and strategic priorities of each account
* Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying cycles across business leadership, IT, procurement, legal, and compliance building consensus and urgency at every stage
* Partner with Solutions Consultants to orchestrate proof-of-value engagements that demonstrate Within’s impact using the prospect’s own data and processes
* Maintain disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting, leveraging MEDDPICC or equivalent qualification frameworks to drive deal rigor
* Travel to meet customers and prospects in person. Face time matters, and presence at critical deal moments is essential to success

**You May Be a Good Fit If You…**

* Have 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota, including at least 3 years selling into Financial Services, banking, insurance, asset management, or Private Equity firms
* Have a proven history of building territory from scratch - you’ve done the zero-to-one work, not just inherited a book of business or rode a wave of inbound leads
* Are skilled at selling to senior executives (VP, SVP, EVP, C-Suite) and can articulate business value in the language of financial outcomes, not just product features
* Possess strong financial acumen - you understand how financial institutions and PE firms operate, how they evaluate technology investments, and what drives their decision-making
* Have experience managing complex, six- and seven-figure enterprise deal cycles with multiple stakeholders, long timelines, and rigorous procurement processes
* Display commitment and resilience with prior employers — we value loyalty and grit, and we’re not looking for candidates who jump every 18–24 months
* Are AI-native, not AI-adjacent - you intuitively understand and use AI in your own daily work to sharpen your craft, not just talk about it in meetings
* Have high coachability with no ego - this world is changing fast, and we need growth-mindset people willing to adapt with it
* Are customer-obsessed with an entrepreneurial spirit, strong opinions, and a bias for action

**Strong Candidates May Also…**

* Have direct experience selling AI or digital transformation technology into Financial Services or PE accounts and can articulate technical differentiation against both technology competitors and consulting-led alternatives
* Bring a rolodex of executive-level relationships across major financial institutions, PE firms, or portfolio companies that can be activated from day one
* Have experience partnering with or selling alongside Big-4 and management consulting firms - you understand how technology vendors co-sell with professional services organizations in financial services
* Have sold into complex regulatory environments and understand the compliance, security, and data governance requirements that Financial Services buyers demand
* Bring a track record of building sales playbooks, account plans, and go-to-market strategies for new verticals from scratch - you’ve done the zero-to-one work, not just executed an existing motion
* Can balance strategic, long-cycle deal management with the hustle and urgency of an early-stage sales organization - and actually enjoy both

**What Within Values in This Hire**

We’re not just hiring a title. We’re hiring a builder. Here’s what matters to us:

* **History of Achievement**: You have a track record of setting ambitious goals and hitting them. Quota attainment isn’t a hope - it’s a habit.
* **Intellectually Curious**: You learn everything about your customers, their industry, and the product - then use that knowledge to delight prospects and win trust.
* **Appetite for Closing**: Passionate about winning. Comfortable asking people to make decisions right now. You drive urgency without creating pressure.
* **Coachable**: You have the desire and ability to take feedback, internalize it, and get measurably better - fast.
* **Scrappy Builder**: Proven track record of building, not just managing. Hungry for the next level and willing to do the unglamorous work to get there.
* **AI Fluent**: You possess a deep understanding and proven track record of using a variety of AI tools across all aspects of the sales process - from discovery to ROI to close. You use AI to sharpen prospecting, manage your time, stay organized, and prioritize your day to maximize results. Building your own Agents and Skills is a plus.
* **Loyalty & Resilience**: Commitment to prior employers. We want people who dig in when things get hard, not people who optimize for optionality.
* **Customer Obsessed**: Entrepreneurial spirit, strong opinions, bias for action. Cares deeply about customer outcomes.
* **Technical Translator**: Can make the complex feel simple. Moves fluidly between deep technical conversations and business-value story telling

**Location & Travel**

This role is based in San Francisco with a heavy focus on prospect and customer meetings. Travel is expected to engage with enterprise customers, attend industry events, support critical deal moments, and build executive relationships. Face time with customers matters - presence at key moments is essential to success.

**Position Summary:**  
  
We have an exciting opening for a Senior Data Analyst within the Ronald O. Perelman Department of Emergency Medicine, Research Division. In this role, the successful candidate will work under the direction of Principal Investigator and Medical Director for Geriatric Emergency Medicine, Dr. Ula Hwang. The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for supporting data management and analyses using clinical, administrative, and operational data, and for planning, designing, and implementing statistical analyses. This will include working with large national and multicenter research network databases, including electronic health record (EHR) and claims data. The individual in this position will support multiple projects in day-to-day activities, including preliminary data analysis, data visualization, predictive and machine learning analytics, causal inference analyses, and results dissemination. All research and programming code must be regularly documented and archived per best practices. Other responsibilities will include coordinating and participating in regular meetings that pertain to data preparation, management, analyses and ongoing research projects. The analyst will communicate information and data in written and verbal form to colleagues as well as project and senior management teams. A successful applicant will be a strong communicator, be curious, inquisitive and resourceful, have a high degree of professional maturity and commitment to excellence, and be able to work autonomously and comfortably on a health services research team in an academic medical center environment.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Demonstrates knowledge of the organizations Core Values and incorporates them into the performance of duties.

Ensures compliance with HIPAA, IRB protocols, and data use agreements.

To qualify you must have a Bachelors Degree and 3-5 years of experience required.

Strong quantitative skills and advanced programming skills in R, Python, SAS, and/or Stata.  
Experience working with EHR clinical data and/or CMS Medicare/Medicaid claims data.

Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills.  
Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative research team.  
Knowledge of principles and methods of biostatistics and epidemiology, including study design, statistical analysis, and causal inference.

title: Procurement Intelligence Analyst
description:
The Procurement Intelligence Analyst develops and delivers the analytics, market intelligence, performance reporting, and data insights that enable Enterprise Procurement to make informed, data-driven decisions. The role transforms procurement, supplier, financial, and operational data into actionable insights supporting category strategy, sourcing, Vendor Management, value realization, risk governance, and executive decision-making. Working collaboratively with Category Management, Vendor Management, Procurement Operations Hub, Finance, the Procurement Center of Excellence (COE), and business stakeholders, the role establishes trusted procurement reporting, spend visibility, supplier and vendor performance analytics, savings measurement, and market intelligence. The Procurement Intelligence Analyst also partners with the Procurement Digital Transformation Lead to advance automated reporting, AI-enabled analytics, and predictive insights as the organization builds a more digitally enabled procurement operating model.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Procurement Analytics, Performance & Executive Reporting**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise procurement dashboards, performance reports, and executive reporting that provide visibility into procurement value, operational performance, supplier performance, and strategic priorities.
* Establish and monitor procurement KPIs including savings and value realization, spend coverage, contract compliance, supplier performance, sourcing activity, cycle times, process efficiency, and stakeholder experience.
* Translate complex procurement data into clear insights, trends, and recommendations that support Procurement Leadership Team and executive decision-making.
* Produce recurring and ad hoc reporting for procurement leadership, governance forums, category reviews, Vendor Management reviews, and enterprise stakeholders.
* Ensure procurement reporting is accurate, timely, consistent, and supported by clearly defined metrics and trusted data sources.

**Spend, Category & Market Intelligence**

* Analyze enterprise spend across categories, suppliers, business units, and service areas to identify sourcing opportunities, demand trends, supplier concentration, and cost optimization opportunities.
* Develop category and supplier intelligence that supports category strategies, sourcing pipelines, negotiations, demand planning, and total cost of ownership analyses.
* Conduct market research and benchmarking across supplier markets, pricing trends, economic indicators, industry developments, and emerging technologies.
* Partner with Category Management to provide fact-based analytical support for category planning, supplier landscape assessments, business cases, and commercial recommendations.
* Maintain enterprise spend visibility and continuously improve spend classification, segmentation, and analytical usability.

**Supplier & Vendor Performance Intelligence**

* Develop and maintain supplier and vendor performance reporting, scorecards, and analytical views in support of Vendor Management and Category Management.
* Aggregate and analyze SLA, KPI, risk, issue, financial, and operational performance data to identify performance trends, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Provide analytical support for QBRs, executive business reviews, vendor governance meetings, supplier segmentation, and strategic account planning.
* Partner with Vendor Leads and business stakeholders to improve scorecard consistency, performance transparency, and actionable supplier insights.

leader in driving business solutions for marketers, known for its highly personal approach to client service.

Job Summary

The main responsibility of the Senior Analyst, Advanced Analytics is to apply sophisticated modeling and

other advanced analytic techniques to help guide our clients' media spending plans and make their

investments more efficient. Advanced analytic techniques may include, but are not limited to, Marketing Mix

Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), and media budget optimizations.

In addition to the technical aspects required, this role involves cultivating and maintaining effective working

relationships with a variety of parties, including clients, internal stakeholders, third-party vendors, external

clients, and operational areas within Horizon. We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious, with

the drive and experience to identify, frame, and solve business problems. The ideal candidate must be a

critical thinker who can provide creative strategic solutions and follow through with flawless execution.

Critical to the role is the ability to provide thought leadership that can drive our capabilities through analytic

innovations.

Multi-Touch Attribution) to provide actionable insights into media planning and buying.

* Process Optimization: Improve the usage of Horizon's existing data and analytics infrastructure. Utilize

automation and technology to boost efficiency and scalability.

* Collaborative KPI Development: Work across media planning and brand strategy teams to develop key

performance indicators (KPIs) and reporting methodologies that align with campaign and brand goals.

* Data Visualization: Build robust data visualizations and interactive dashboards that deliver complex

information in an intelligent and digestible manner.

* Database Querying & Analysis: Query database tables into formats suitable for analysis and

visualization. Analyze raw data, draw conclusions, and summarize actionable recommendations with

forecasted outcomes and implications.

* Stakeholder Management: Manage client expectations and present key findings throughout

engagements. Communicate concise data points, trends, and measurement strategies to audiences

ranging from technical developers to traditional brand managers.

* Education: Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.

* Experience: 1-2 years of industry experience (2-3 years of relevant analytical experience preferred);

advanced analytics and media evaluation experience is highly desired.

title: Test Failure Analyst
description:
***Who We Are***

ZT Systems is an established multibillion-dollar technology company with 31 years in business. We are one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. At ZT Systems, we put **people first** , and from day one our team members take on an **ownership mentality** . We are passionate about **teamwork** , and the consistent high **quality** of our solutions differentiates us in the minds of our customers.

  

***What We Do***

ZT engineers hyperscale compute and storage solutions that are tailored to the unique workloads and business needs of our global datacenter customers. With the proven ability to deliver these solutions, ZT Systems is well positioned as the design, manufacturing and logistics partner of choice for hyperscale compute and storage customers.

  

***What You’ll Do***

The **Test Failure Analyst** is responsible for driving manufacturing test yield performance through failure analysis, yield management, and cross-functional issue resolution. This role serves as the central point of coordination between manufacturing, test engineering, quality, firmware, hardware, and system engineering teams to ensure failures are accurately documented, effectively investigated, and resolved through sustainable preventive actions.

* Own and manage manufacturing test yield performance across NPI and production programs.

* Develop and maintain yield bridge analysis to quantify key yield gains and losses and identify primary yield detractors.

* Analyze test and repair data to identify failure trends, recurring issues, and emerging quality risks.

* Lead cross-functional reviews to prioritize yield-impacting failures and drive timely root cause investigations.

* Coordinate debug activities across Failure Analysis, Test, Quality, Firmware, Hardware, System Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.

* Ensure manufacturing test failures are properly documented, classified, and tracked throughout the investigation lifecycle.

* Maintain clear traceability between failure symptoms, root causes, corrective actions, and resulting yield improvements.

* Establish and manage a centralized failure database and knowledge repository to improve troubleshooting efficiency and prevent recurring issues.

* Publish regular yield, failure, and corrective action reports for engineering leadership and executive stakeholders.

* Drive containment plans, corrective actions, and long-term preventive measures for quality and yield issues.

* Monitor corrective action effectiveness and verify sustained resolution of identified issues.

* Support factory operations by providing rapid issue triage, escalation management, and recovery planning for critical yield events.

* Collaborate with Quality and Manufacturing teams to improve test processes, repair procedures, and operational efficiencies.

Capture and communicate lessons learned to improve future product launches and manufacturing readiness.  



**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering, Operations Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

* 2+ years of experience in manufacturing, operations, quality, analytics, program management, test engineering, or a related environment.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and identify trends.

* Experience working with data analysis and reporting tools such as Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

* Ability to organize and track multiple issues while driving actions across cross-functional teams.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

* Experience documenting processes, investigations, and corrective actions in a structured and organized manner.

Demonstrated ability to manage priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience in manufacturing operations, quality management, testing, failure analysis, or supply chain environments.

* Understanding of hardware products, electronics manufacturing, server systems, or data center technologies.

* Experience supporting cross-functional teams through issue management and project coordination.

* Lean Six Sigma certification or exposure to process improvement methodologies.

We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. PIMCO is seeking an Account Associate to join the Financial Institutions Group (FIG) Insurance team, with a focus on business development. As part of the U.S. FIG team of more than 25 investment professionals and associates, you will partner with Account Managers to identify and develop prospective insurance relationships, conduct company and industry research, prepare for client engagements, and support opportunities from initial outreach through onboarding.

The role combines analytical work with commercial execution. You will develop an understanding of prospective clients’ businesses, investment portfolios, and priorities and help connect those needs with PIMCO’s investment capabilities across public and private markets. You will contribute to prospect strategy, client presentations, proposals, and other business development initiatives while coordinating across investment and functional teams.

The team uses data, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance research, improve prospect and client engagement, and operate more efficiently. You will apply these tools with sound judgment while identifying opportunities to improve and automate recurring workflows.

This role offers significant exposure to insurance investors, investment specialists, and senior relationship managers. You will build expertise in insurance investing, financial analysis, business development, and client communication while taking on increasing responsibility for client presentations and prospect-related initiatives as your knowledge and experience develop.

**Key Relationships**

* PIMCO Investment Professionals including Account Managers, Product and Solutions Strategists, Capital Markets, Credit Research Analysts and Portfolio Managers
* Internal partners across analytics, marketing, legal, compliance, operations, and technology teams in the U.S. and globally.
* Prospective insurance clients and external partners, including consultants, investment banks, and law firms.

**About You**

You are intellectually curious, commercially minded, and energized by building relationships and identifying new opportunities. You bring integrity, sound judgment, initiative, and strong communication skills to your work. You are comfortable using data, technology, and AI to develop insights, solve problems, and drive better outcomes. Above all, your work reflects PIMCO’s values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility, and Excellence.

**Location**

This role will be based in New York, NY.

**Responsibilities**

Key responsibilities include:

* **Insurance Industry & Prospect Research**: Conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis of insurance companies, industry developments, and competitors. Analyze insurance companies’ financial statements, investment portfolios, and business priorities to help identify relevant investment strategies and prospective clients.
* **Business Development & Client Engagement**: Partner with FIG Account Managers and Product Strategists to prioritize prospects, tailor outreach, and prepare for meetings and conferences. Participate in client discussions and take on presentation responsibilities as knowledge and experience develop.
* **Investment Solutions & Marketing Materials**: Prepare and update presentations and marketing materials for prospective and existing clients. Support the investment process with research and analysis for insurance-focused investment solutions.
* **Proposals & Due Diligence**: Coordinate responses to requests for proposals and due diligence questionnaires, gathering input from relevant teams. Partner with Solutions Strategists to prepare materials illustrating proposed model portfolio materials.
* **Business Planning & Growth Analysis**: Support business planning by researching competitors and analyzing trends across the team’s target strategies. Track investment flows and product growth trends to help the team prioritize prospective clients and outreach.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination & Onboarding**: Coordinate with investment professionals and internal teams to follow up on prospective-client requests and support the setup of new investment mandates.
* **AI & Workflow Optimization**: Use data and AI-enabled tools to streamline research, meeting preparation, and reporting. Validate outputs and identify recurring tasks suited to automation.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; preferred fields include Business (Finance or Accounting), Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Engineering. Progress toward the CFA or CAIA designation or an advanced degree is a plus.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in financial services, asset management, investment banking, investment consulting, actuarial consulting, accounting, or insurance balance sheet strategy.
* Completion of Series 7 and 63 within the first six (6) months of employment
* Prior insurance-sector experience is helpful but not required; an interest in learning how insurance companies invest is essential.
* Working knowledge of fixed income markets and instruments, with an interest in deepening expertise in public and private credit and insurance investment portfolios.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint required. Familiarity with financial databases such as Bloomberg or SNL Financial is preferred; experience with SQL or other data-query tools is a plus.

* Ability to take initiative, manage multiple assignments, and build productive working relationships.

**Professional Skills Requirements**

* **Execution & Problem Solving**: Turns research into practical next steps and follows through on deliverables with accuracy and attention to detail.
* **Communication & Collaboration**: Presents analysis clearly and coordinates inputs across teams to keep prospect and client work moving.
* **Adaptability & Integrity**: Responds constructively to changing priorities, seeks feedback, and exercises sound judgment when handling information and using technology.

**Join Goodwin’s Global Operations Team, and make a real impact on a global scale.** At Goodwin, we work with some of the world’s most successful and innovative investors, entrepreneurs and disruptors in the life sciences, private equity, real estate, technology and financial industries, and where they converge. As part of the Global Operations Team – all business professionals at the firm – you’ll collaborate with colleagues from varied backgrounds and experiences, fostering an environment where cross-functional learning, networking, and collaboration are at the core of what we do.  
  
**Here, we’re not just supporting a law firm; we’re partnering with attorneys and clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions** in high-stakes litigation and dispute resolution, world-class regulatory compliance and advisory services, and complex transactions. Our commitment to integrity, ingenuity, agility, and ambition drives us, and we’re proud to have been recognised as the “Best Business Team” by The American Lawyer.  
  
This is your opportunity to grow professionally in a dynamic, global environment, surrounded by forward-thinking peers.

The Manager, Compensation leads firmwide annual compensation cycle and delivery of the firm’s global compensation programs for legal and business support populations. The role manages annual salary and incentive cycles, market benchmarking, salary structures analysis, survey database management and Workday compensation data and systems. Working closely with HR Business Partners, HRIS, Finance, and firm leaders, the Manager ensures compensation programs are accurate, competitive and aligned with business needs.

**What You Will Do:**

**Compensation Cycle Management**

* Lead the annual salary and incentive compensation cycles for global legal and business support populations, ensuring accurate and timely execution.
* Develop cost analyses and budget models in partnership with Finance for various pay groups across the firm.
* Coordinate the Performance and Compensation Review project plan and related manager communications with HR stakeholders.

**Market Benchmarking and Job Evaluation**

* Manage survey participation, including budgets, schedules, invoices, data submissions, and vendor relationships.
* Optimize the firm’s benchmarking capabilities within MarketPay.
* Evaluate new and existing roles based on market data and internal equity considerations. Recommend appropriate job levels and FLSA classifications.
* Review salary structures, geographic differentials, and market movement and recommend adjustments based on business needs and market data.
* Review survey submissions prepared by analysts for accuracy and completeness.

**Systems and Process Improvement**

* Manage data within Workday and MarketPay and drive the continuous improvement of supporting systems and workflows.
* Establish audit cadence of salary ranges, job profiles, market matches to maintain accuracy, consistency, and appropriate controls.
* Work with HRIS to support the design, testing, implementation, and maintenance of compensation business processes and system enhancements.
* Support the automation of legal group processes for year end planning.

**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner with HRIS, Finance, Payroll, Benefits, HR Operations, and HR Business Partners to meet compensation deliverables and business objectives.
* Advise HR Business Partners, managers, and firm leaders on compensation matters and provide analysis to support informed and consistent decision making.

**Communications, and Documentation**

* Develop training materials and communications on compensation education and Workday compensation planning.
* Create and maintain process documentation, project plans, timelines, and operating procedures.

**Projects Management**

* Drive compensation projects and initiatives, including job architecture, incentive program design, market-data refinement and system enhancements.
* Support other Total Rewards and HR initiatives.

**Who You Are:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent, CCP certification a plus.
* 7+ years of related experience.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, preferably Workday. MarketPay experience desirable.
* Proficiency with Word, PowerPoint, Outlook.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data validation, modeling, and the development of clear analytical outputsExcellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and customer service skills.
* Strong project management and organization skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in developing and managing spreadsheets as well as experience implementing and/or managing various software applications.
* High level of attention to detail – ensure the integrity/accuracy of data.
* Ability to protect and maintain confidential and sensitive information.

title: TV Analyst
description:
**About ASCAP**

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

**Job Overview:**

The TV Analyst is responsible for assisting both the TV Team Leader and other TV Distribution team members with the processing of audio and visual programming, sharing in the overall responsibility of ensuring that ASCAP members are properly credited for the performance of their works in audio/visual media.

Successful completion of these efforts requires the careful analysis of television performance, promo, and cue sheet data. TV Analysts will associate programs and promos with performances, verify the accuracy of any data provided, procure and upload any missing data, identify and reconcile discrepancies, and participate in quality assurance procedures to ensure that ASCAP members are accurately paid. The TV Analyst position reports to the TV Team Leader, is situated within the TV Distribution department, and is based out of ASCAP’s New York City office. This is a hybrid position with currently a minimum 1 day per week in-office requirement.

**Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:**

* Identify and match cue sheets to performances.
* Request missing or incomplete cue sheets from suppliers.
* Upload missing performances to the performance database.
* Reconcile the station count and any informational discrepancies within performance data.
* Verify cue sheet content.
* Assign and create work records for cues.
* Control check work records and performances that have been matched by 3rd party vendors.
* Integrate music video programming into distribution.
* Assist with the timely resolution of member-initiated inquiries.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, relevant work experience accepted.
* 1+ years of relevant work experience.
* Strong analytical skills and basic research adeptness.
* Highly organized with the ability to prioritize.
* Skilled at handling multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Access) and internet applications.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self-starter, independent, and self-sufficient.
* Ability to work and interact with team members on a remote basis.
* Ability to connect and communicate with people at all levels of business and management.
* Performs with both a positive attitude and commitment to being a team player.
* Interest in music, music licensing, and/or the TV and Film industry is preferred.
* This position currently requires the incumbent to be in the office one day per week. In-office requirements are subject to change.

**Compensation/Benefits:**

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

* A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
* Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
* 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
* An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
* Generous time-off policy
* Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
* Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
* Company-provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
* Employee gym discounts at select gyms
* Commuter benefits
* Voluntary pet health insurance
* Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
* Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
* Voluntary ID protection coverage

The above summary of the current benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the benefit plan documents. This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Please note that ASCAP reserves the right to amend or otherwise revise or terminate, at any time and in its sole discretion, its benefit plans, programs, and policies.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $50,000 to $50,000 and will be determined on an individualized basis depending on several factors that are unique to each candidate including geographic location (due to differences in the cost of labor), skills, education and prior relevant experience.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Business Line of Credit Lifecycle Marketing, this role will own lifecycle initiatives and campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement, while contributing to the broader lifecycle strategy.

* Strong data aptitude and analytical rigor with the ability to translate data and customer insights into actionable recommendations.

* Demonstrated ability to own initiatives from planning through execution and measurement while effectively managing multiple priorities and stakeholders.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners in a fast-paced environment.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
